description:
Other mixed for Volcano, Cabo Verde, 24 November 2014 (VO20141124CPV): 1 features merged from 1 source layer. Mixed layers that match none of the named groups. The source layer names below say what each holds. The `source_layer` and `source_file` columns name the layer and file each row came from.

From these HDX datasets:

- [Geodata of Pico de Fogo Volcanic Eruption, Fogo Island, Cape Verde - Impact](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/geodata-of-pico-de-fogo-volcanic-eruption-fogo-island-cape-verde-impact-november-28-2014)

Read [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) for the columns and query recipes.

table:columns.description: Name of the layer in the source file that this row came from.

table:columns.description: Name of the file downloaded from HDX that this row came from.

table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
table:columns.description: Bounding box of the geometry (xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax), added for spatial filtering.
